extractions.value: Core diagnostic criteria: stiffness and rigidity in axial muscles, abnormal axial posture, stimulus-sensitive spasms, electromyographic evidence of continuous motor unit activity. Negative criteria: absent brainstem, pyramidal, extrapyramidal and lower motor neuron signs, no sphincter disturbance, no sensory disturbance, absence of chronic pain syndrome, no cognitive impairment.
